next.reason: §2023:12.4.5.3 GR2: 'The OPTIONAL phrase applies only to files opened in the input, I-O, or extend mode' and is required for files not always present. A report file may be opened only 'with the OUTPUT or EXTEND phrase' (§2023:13.18.46.3 SR3), so OPTIONAL still applies to a report file only in extend mode, as 1985 says.
